classification.difficultyReason: The height is not given. The student must spot the right triangle formed by the dashed diagonal, the 8 cm side and the unlabelled vertical side, and find the height by Pythagoras. They must also identify the parallel sides, then reverse the trapezium area formula to solve for the base. There is more unsignposted structure than in the lower variant.

content.prompt: Work out the length of the unknown side, if the area is $180\text{ cm}^2$.

answer.worked:
The diagonal, the left side and the top side form a right triangle, so the left side is the height $h$.
$$\begin{align*}h^2&=17^2-8^2\\h^2&=225\\h&=15\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\180&=\frac{15(8+b)}{2}\\360&=15(8+b)\\24&=8+b\\b&=16\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
